module Concurrency.StructuredScopeHandleEscape

type Invoice is record
    id: Integer
end record

async function load_invoice(id: Integer) returns Invoice
is
    return Invoice { id: id }
end load_invoice

async function handle(id: Integer) returns JoinHandle<Invoice>
is
    scope request_scope do
        spawn
            let invoice_handle: JoinHandle<Invoice> = request_scope.spawn<Invoice>(load_invoice(id))
        join
        result
            return invoice_handle
    end scope
end handle

end Concurrency.StructuredScopeHandleEscape
